sentences.text: शाम को रवि और मीरा दादी के पास बैठे।
sentences.english: In the evening Ravi and Mira sat down beside Grandma.
Mira said, "Grandma, please tell a story."
Grandma said, "All right, listen."

sentences.text: मोती भी आ गया और दादी के पास बैठ गया।
sentences.english: Moti came too and sat down beside Grandma.
Grandma asked, "Which story?"
Ravi said, "The crow's story."
Grandma began the story.

sentences.text: रवि और मीरा ध्यान से सुन रहे थे।
sentences.english: Ravi and Mira were listening carefully.
Moti was sitting quietly too.
There was a crow.
It was a hot day.
The crow felt very thirsty.

sentences.text: उसने पानी ढूँढा, लेकिन कहीं पानी नहीं था।
sentences.english: He looked for water, but there was no water anywhere.
The crow flew up into the sky.

sentences.text: उसने नदी ढूँढी, लेकिन नदी बहुत दूर थी।
sentences.english: He looked for a river, but the river was very far.

sentences.text: उसने तालाब ढूँढा, लेकिन तालाब में पानी नहीं था।
sentences.english: He looked for a pond, but there was no water in the pond.
The crow got very tired.
Then he saw a house.

sentences.text: घर के आँगन में एक घड़ा था।
sentences.english: In the courtyard of the house there was a pot.
The crow went up to the pot.
He looked into the pot.

sentences.text: घड़े में पानी था, लेकिन बहुत नीचे।
sentences.english: There was water in the pot, but far down.
The crow could not reach the water.
The crow thought.
There were many pebbles in the courtyard.
The crow picked up a pebble.

sentences.text: उसने कंकड़ घड़े में डाल दिया।
sentences.english: He dropped the pebble into the pot.
Then he dropped a second pebble.
The crow dropped many pebbles.
The water came up.
The crow drank the water.

sentences.text: फिर वह आसमान में उड़ गया।
sentences.english: Then he flew off into the sky.

sentences.text: दादी ने कहा, "जब हम सोचते हैं, तब हमें रास्ता मिल जाता है।"
sentences.english: Grandma said, "When we think, we find a way."

sentences.text: मीरा ने कहा, "दादी, कहानी बहुत अच्छी है।"
sentences.english: Mira said, "Grandma, the story is very good."

sentences.text: रवि ने पूछा, "दादी, कौआ कहाँ गया?"
sentences.english: Ravi asked, "Grandma, where did the crow go?"

sentences.text: दादी हँसने लगीं और बोलीं, "वह अपने घर गया।"
sentences.english: Grandma started laughing and said, "He went to his home."

sentences.text: रवि ने कहा, "दादी, एक कहानी और सुनाइए।"
sentences.english: Ravi said, "Grandma, please tell one more story."

sentences.text: दादी ने कहा, "अब रात हो गई है।"
sentences.english: Grandma said, "It is night now."

sentences.text: दादी ने रवि और मीरा को दूध दिया।
sentences.english: Grandma gave Ravi and Mira milk.
Both of them drank the milk.
Moti listened to the story too.
Moti fell asleep.
